actualObservation.message: Frozen metric assertion differs from source facts: taxPendingAmount

cause.G: context::build preserves unknown/null tax-assessment-missing when actual cost tax is nonzero/unknown and no assessment exists. Source tax650 is not an assessed pending tax amount.
cause.H: assert_metrics calls sum(empty tax_treatments), which returns Some(0) from its known zero initial state; strict amount returnsNone for G unknown and rejects.
cause.loader: hash/schema/ref checks do not manufacture zero and remain unchanged.
cause.adjacentMaturity: optional_pending did not inspect unknown metrics.taxPendingAmount, so an assert-only fix would wrongly allow mature/normal despite the frozen tax-uncertainty contract.

minimalFix: H independently determines missing assessment from the same frozen source cost-tax/assessment presence, then assertsNone or actual assessment sum.
Keep strict amount/assert_amount, exact canonical cents, unknown null/noZeroProof and source-specific missing-assessment reason; forged known0 still rejects.
Treat unknown pending-tax as optional pending (H02/preliminary), not hard admission loss, and never H11 normal merely because the assessment vector is empty.
unchanged: all source ratios and financial assertions

maturity: insufficient if necessary effective contract/confirmed receipt basis/explicit classified cost scope/factual layer missing. Ordinary review cannot change this. Official eligibility guard applies separately.
preliminary if necessary evidence exists but pending/unmapped/tax/allocation/restatement uncertainty remains, even when its qualitative materiality has been reviewed.
mature only complete classified known current-scope sources with no pending gaps/corrections/restatements; maturity is not risk normality.
risk: Auto risk/alert for proven negative margin only when known facts, mature, receipt ratio>=0.20 and receipt net>0. Independent authoritative cost BLOCK survives regardless receipt ratio.

Negative observed margin at low/zero receipts or immature data => qualitative-materiality-unassessed, unknown risk/signal and explicit manual review; preserve independent cost/formula/maturity/restatement actions.

Any adverse positive cost variance or pending impact with only qualitative materiality adds unassessed review. No invented amount/percentage threshold. Verified manual review classifies only exact qualitative issues normal/attention/risk, not facts or maturity.
normal only complete facts and no automatic risk/attention or unresolved qualitative issues. unknown never means normal or confirmed release.
